english: No matter how busy you are, he always insists on coming with you.
text: No matter how busy you are 把忙碌程度全部纳入让步：再忙也改变不了他要跟来的态度。说‘无论多……都……’，可以用 no matter how 加具体程度；这里比只说 when you are busy 更突出结果不受条件影响。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
